_comment: Prop-firm trading mode configuration for HOPEFX AI Trading.
_description: Defines drawdown, daily-loss, and position-sizing rules for FTMO and Goat Funded (and compatible) prop-firm evaluation and funded accounts. Set 'enabled: true' and choose an 'active_firm' to enforce these rules at runtime.

drawdown._total_note: Account equity must never fall more than 10 % below the INITIAL balance (hard breach = immediate disqualification).
drawdown._daily_note: Equity (or balance, whichever is lower) must not fall more than 5 % below the START-OF-DAY equity in a single trading day.
drawdown._mode_note: FTMO measures drawdown on floating equity, not closed balance alone.

profit_target._note: Profit targets apply only during evaluation phases; no profit target on funded accounts.

trading_days._note: Minimum number of calendar days with at least one executed trade.

position_limits._note: FTMO does not impose explicit lot or position-count limits; normal margin rules apply.

ftmo_standard._risk_note: Recommended internal rule: risk no more than 1 % of account per trade.

news_trading._note: FTMO allows news trading on Standard accounts unless individual instrument is restricted.

drawdown._total_note: Overall maximum drawdown from initial balance; breach = account termination.
drawdown._daily_note: Maximum allowable daily loss from the equity high-water mark at midnight server time.
drawdown._mode_note: Goat Funded measures daily drawdown from the BALANCE (closed P&L) at the start of each day.

news_trading._note: Goat Funded prohibits holding positions through high-impact news events.

overnight_holding._note: Positions must be closed before Friday 21:00 UTC on funded accounts.

enforcement._alert_note: Emit a warning when daily drawdown reaches this percentage of the daily limit (e.g. 80 % of 5 % = 4 %).
